an5.140:1.1: [sāvatthinidānaṃ] pañcahi bhikkhave aṅgehi samannāgato rañño nāgo rājāraho hoti rājabhoggo. rañño aṅgantveva saṅkhaṃ gacchati.
an5.140:1.3: idha bhikkhave rañño nāgo sotā ca hoti, hantā ca, rakkhitā ca, khantā ca, gantā ca.
an5.140:2.1: kathañca bhikkhave rañño nāgo sotā hoti?
an5.140:2.2: idha bhikkhave rañño nāgo yamenaṃ hatthidammasārathī kāraṇaṃ kāreti
an5.140:2.3: yadi vā katapubbaṃ yadi vā akatapubbaṃ,
an5.140:2.4: taṃ aṭṭhikatvā manasikatvā sabbacetaso samannāharitvā ohitasoto suṇāti.
an5.140:2.5: evaṃ kho bhikkhave rañño nāgo sotā hoti.
an5.140:3.1: kathañca bhikkhave rañño nāgo hantā hoti?
an5.140:3.2: idha bhikkhave rañño nāgo saṅgāmagato hatthimpi hanti, hatthāruhampi hanti. assampi hanti, assāruhampi hanti. rathampi hanti rathiyampi hanti. pattikampi hanti.
an5.140:3.3: evaṃ kho bhikkhave rañño nāgo hantā hoti.
an5.140:4.1: kathañca bhikkhave rañño nāgo rakkhitā hoti?
an5.140:4.2: idha bhikkhave rañño nāgo saṅgāmagato rakkhati purimaṃ kāyaṃ, rakkhati pacchimaṃ kāyaṃ. rakkhati purime pāde, rakkhati pacchime pāde. rakkhati sīsaṃ, rakkhati kāṇe, rakkhati dante, rakkhati soṇḍaṃ, rakkhati vāladhiṃ, rakkhati hatthāruhaṃ.
an5.140:4.3: evaṃ kho bhikkhave rañño nāgo rakkhitā hoti.
an5.140:5.1: kathañca bhikkhave rañño nāgo khantā hoti?
an5.140:5.2: idha bhikkhave rañño nāgo khamo hoti sattippahārānaṃ, asippahārānaṃ, usuppahārānaṃ, pharasuppahārānaṃ, bheripaṇavasaṅkhatiṇavaninnādasaddānaṃ.
an5.140:5.3: evaṃ kho bhikkhave rañño nāgo khantā hoti.
an5.140:6.1: kathañca bhikkhave rañño nāgo gantā hoti?
an5.140:6.2: idha bhikkhave rañño nāgo yamenaṃ hatthidammasārathī disaṃ peseti
an5.140:6.5: evaṃ kho bhikkhave rañño nāgo gantā hoti.
an5.140:7.1: imehi kho bhikkhave pañcahi aṅgehi samannāgato rañño nāgo rājāraho hoti rājabhoggo. rañño aṅgantveva saṅkhaṃ gacchati.
an5.140:8.1: evameva kho bhikkhave pañcahi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu āhuneyyo hoti pāhuneyyo dakkhiṇeyyo añjalikaraṇīyo anuttaraṃ puññakkhettaṃ lokassa.
an5.140:8.3: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu sotā ca hoti, hantā ca, rakkhitā ca, khantā ca, gantā ca.
an5.140:9.2: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu tathāgatappavedite dhammavinaye desiyamāne aṭṭhikatvā manasikatvā sabbacetaso samannāharitvā ohitasoto dhammaṃ suṇāti.
an5.140:9.3: evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu sotā hoti.
an5.140:10.2: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu uppannaṃ kāmavitakkaṃ nādhivāseti pajahati vinodeti byantīkaroti anabhāvaṃ gameti. uppannaṃ vyāpādavitakkaṃ nādhivāseti pajahati vinodeti byantīkaroti anabhāvaṃ gameti. uppannaṃ vihiṃsāvitakkaṃ nādhivāseti pajahati vinodeti byantīkaroti anabhāvaṃ gameti. uppannuppanne pāpake akusale dhamme nādhivāseti pajahati vinodeti byantīkaroti anabhāvaṃ gameti.
an5.140:10.3: evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu hantā hoti.
an5.140:11.2: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu cakkhunā rūpaṃ disvā na nimittaggāhī nānubyañjanaggāhī.
an5.140:11.3: yatvādhikaraṇametaṃ cakkhundriyaṃ asaṃvutaṃ viharantaṃ abhijjhādomanassā pāpakā akusalā dhammā anvāssaveyyuṃ, tassa saṃvarāya paṭipajjati. rakkhati cakkhundriyaṃ, cakkhundriye saṃvaraṃ āpajjati.
an5.140:11.8: manasā dhammaṃ viññāya na nimittaggāhī hoti nānubyañjanaggāhī.
an5.140:11.9: yatvādhikaraṇametaṃ manindriyaṃ asaṃvutaṃ viharantaṃ abhijjhādomanassā pāpakā akusalā dhammā anvāssaveyyuṃ, tassa saṃvarāya paṭipajjati. rakkhati manindriyaṃ, manindriye saṃvaraṃ āpajjati.
an5.140:11.10: evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu rakkhitā hoti.
an5.140:12.2: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu khamo hoti sītassa uṇhassa jighacchāya pipāsāya ḍaṃsamakasavātātapasiriṃsapasamphassānaṃ, duruttānaṃ durāgatānaṃ vacanapathānaṃ. uppannānaṃ sārīrikānaṃ vedanānaṃ dukkhānaṃ tippānaṃ kharānaṃ kaṭukānaṃ asātānaṃ amanāpānaṃ pāṇaharānaṃ adhivāsakajātiko hoti.
an5.140:12.3: evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu khantā hoti.
an5.140:13.2: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu yā sā disā agatapubbā iminā dīghena addhunā yadidaṃ sabbasaṃkhārasamatho sabbūpadhi paṭinissaggo taṇhakkhayo virāgo nirodho nibbānaṃ, taṃ khippaññeva gantā hoti.
an5.140:13.3: evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu gantā hoti.
an5.140:14.1: imehi kho bhikkhave pañcahi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu āhuneyyo hoti pāhuneyyo dakkhiṇeyyo añjalikaraṇīyo anuttaraṃ puññakkhettaṃ lokassāti.
